entities.name: Founding of Benalia
entities.description: The event on Aerona in which Torsten Von Ursus seized power in Benfosa and founded the nation of Benalia.

entities.name: Torsten Von Ursus
entities.description: A brutal, charismatic leader who founded Benalia, died at seventy-two and left the Lost Edict.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Nation (and city, formerly Benfosa) founded by Torsten, a name meaning aspiration.

entities.name: Benfosa
entities.description: Fading capital of the Sheoltun Empire, renamed Benalia City.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: The domain of Dominaria where Benalia was founded.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Benalia was founded.

entities.name: Sheoltun Empire
entities.description: A steadily collapsing empire whose capital was Benfosa.

entities.name: Lost Edict
entities.description: Torsten's legendary edict consigning Benalia to the alternating care of his seven lieutenants and their families.

entities.name: Seven Benalish clans
entities.description: Clans springing from Torsten's seven lieutenants and their families.

entities.name: Serranism
entities.description: A religion banned in Benalia because of its role in the Uprising in Epityr, later widespread.

entities.name: Uprising in Epityr
entities.description: Uprising that initiated the collapse of Sheoltun.

entities.name: Devas
entities.description: Village founded by refugees from Serra's Realm.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: Realm from which refugees came to found Devas.

entities.name: Clan Capashen
entities.description: A Benalish clan whose scions Devas taught the art of battle.

entities.name: Sursi
entities.description: A place included in Benalia where Serranism became widespread.

entities.name: Cathedral of Serra
entities.description: A cathedral in Benalia, a centre of Serranism.

events.summary: Torsten Von Ursus seized power in Benfosa, renamed it Benalia City and named the nation Benalia.
events.quote: The Founding of Benalia occurred when Torsten Von Ursus seized power in Benfosa

events.summary: Torsten died at seventy-two, leaving the Lost Edict that consigned Benalia to his seven lieutenants and their families.
events.quote: he died at the age of seventy-two, leaving behind the legendary Lost Edict

events.summary: Serranism was banned in Benalia because of its role in the Uprising in Epityr.
events.quote: Serranism was specifically banned in Benalia

events.summary: Refugees from Serra's Realm founded Devas, which Urza mediated a place for in Benalia teaching Clan Capashen scions battle.
events.quote: until refugees from Serra's Realm founded the village of Devas

relations.quote: he brought an entire nation into being using nothing more than the force of his will

relations.note: Its fading capital before the founding.
relations.quote: had been the fading capital of the steadily collapsing Sheoltun Empire
